item.title: Dismal first half, defensive breakdowns fuel Auburn's 96-84 loss at No. 16 Alabama
item.description: In its regular-season finale, and with its postseason hopes hanging in the balance, Auburn delivered a flat first-half performance that proved too much to overcome on Saturday night. A sluggish start and defensive breakdowns fueled the Tigers’ 96-84 loss to its archrival No. 16 Alabama at Coleman Coliseum, marking the third straight loss in the series. item.title: Bodies recovered after plane crash in Bon Secour Bay
item.description: The Gulf Shores Police Department confirmed two bodies were pulled from Bon Secour Bay after a small plane crash.Multiple agencies responded Saturday to the area of Sailboat Bay and Plash Island around 7 p.m. after receiving reports of the crash.
